column2: [intro]
One day at the circus, I got quite a shock,
A clown appeared right on my back like a rock.
He made me laugh, but I also shook with fear,
Those red noses give me sleepless nights, it’s clear.
Clowns, oh clowns, I just can’t stand,
Their funny faces make me feel so unplanned.
Clowns, oh clowns, I can't abide,
Their humor’s too strange for me to confide.
They wear huge shoes, their makeup’s a sight,
They juggle and dance with all their might.
They spin and they twirl, it’s quite a show,
But I’d rather listen to love songs, you know.
Clowns, oh clowns, I just can’t stand,
Their funny faces make me feel so unplanned.
Clowns, oh clowns, I can't abide,
Their humor’s too strange for me to confide.
[ solo ]
So don’t get mad, dear audience,
It’s just a song, no need for pretense.
Clowns will still make a grand sensation,
But I’ll remain the king of imitation.
[outro]
